div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-performance-metric-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: The proportion of evaluated cases for which the AI system produced the correct result.
The proportion of relevant positive cases correctly identified by the AI system.
The proportion of relevant negative cases correctly identified by the AI system.
The ability of the AI system to maintain appropriate performance under variations, disturbances, or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use.
